title: Authorship of the 2024 LLM Medical Applications Survey
summary: This community centers on the 2024 arXiv survey titled "A Survey on Large Language Models from General Purpose to Medical Applications: Datasets, Methodologies, and Evaluations." The cluster consists exclusively of the paper and its eight authors, who are linked solely through their contribution to this specific publication. The group represents a collaborative academic effort to synthesize research on LLMs in the medical domain.
key_findings: The central entity is a survey paper published on arXiv in 2024 (arXiv:2406.10303) focusing on LLMs in medical applications.
The survey was authored by a team of eight researchers: Daniel Tesfai, Huansheng Ning, Jinqiang Wang, Qikai Wei, Runhe Huang, Tao Zhu, Wenwei Mao, and Yi Peng.
All internal relationships within this community are 'AUTHORED_BY' links connecting the paper to its respective authors.
The paper specifically addresses datasets, methodologies, and evaluations for LLMs transitioning from general purpose to medical use.
The author list is consistent across all relationship entries, confirming a single collaborative work rather than multiple distinct publications.
